messages.content: The Westin just emailed that the beach crossover closest to the hotel will be closed during our August 22-28 stay. Before I decide anything, check what that actually does to the walk and compare the current six-night cost with the Seafarer again. I still have a few days to cancel the Westin, correct?

Yes. Confirmation WJI-8247316 can still be canceled without penalty through 11:59 p.m. Jekyll Island local time on August 18, so there are four days left. The closure applies throughout your stay and blocks the Westin's ocean-side boardwalk connection. The hotel is directing guests south on the paved promenade to the next open public crossover, which it estimates at about a ten-minute walk from the lobby before reaching the dune path. I’ll verify the available room and full current total at the Seafarer for the same six nights.
Please make sure the ten minutes is to the crossover, not all the way onto the beach. And I want the Seafarer route spelled out too, including the road crossing.

Confirmed: the Westin's estimate is about ten minutes from the lobby to the entrance of the alternate crossover. The dune walk from there to the sand adds roughly two minutes, so allow about twelve minutes each way under ordinary conditions. At the Seafarer, the route starts at the front side of the property, crosses two-lane North Beachview Drive at the marked pedestrian crossing, and continues on the public dune path opposite the hotel. It is about three to five minutes from the suite building to the sand, depending on where the room is located. That public crossover is not included in the announced closure.
So the hotel that is actually on the beach would temporarily have the longer beach walk. That changes the value quite a bit. What room is open at the Seafarer now?

The Seafarer still has a one-bedroom king suite for two adults from Saturday, August 22 through Friday, August 28. It has a king bedroom, separate sitting room, kitchenette, and one bathroom. The current total is $1,493.16 for all six nights, including estimated taxes. Parking is included, and I found no mandatory resort fee.
Is that the final lodging total, or could a fee appear at checkout? Compare it directly with what remains on the Westin reservation.

The $1,493.16 is the checkout total shown for the Seafarer room: $1,332.00 in room charges plus $161.16 in taxes. No resort, destination, parking, or booking fee is listed. Incidental purchases would be separate. Your Westin total remains $2,065.68, of which $344.28 has already been charged and $1,721.40 is due at the hotel. Switching would reduce the lodging cost by $572.52.
And the Westin is not offering a discount because of the closure?

No automatic rate reduction or fee waiver is attached to your reservation. The hotel says the destination charge remains in place because its other included services continue, and the closure notice only provides the alternate walking route. Your partial ocean-view king and total are otherwise unchanged.
What is the cancellation rule on the Seafarer room today? I do not want to trade a refundable booking for a nonrefundable one while we think.

The available Seafarer rate can be canceled without charge until 4:00 p.m. Jekyll Island local time on August 20. After that, the stated penalty is one night's room charge plus tax. Payment is due at check-in, though a card is required to hold the reservation.

Let me be certain about the practical comparison. Westin: no street crossing, but about twelve minutes to the sand during our dates. Seafarer: cross a two-lane road at a marked crossing, then about three to five minutes total. Is that accurate?

That is accurate based on the current notices and route information. The Westin route stays on the ocean side of the main road but detours south to the next open crossover, for approximately twelve minutes from lobby to sand. The Seafarer route crosses North Beachview Drive at the marked crossing and uses the open public dune path, for approximately three to five minutes from the suite building to sand.
Does the closure affect the partial ocean view itself, or are we only talking about access?

Only access is identified in the notice. There is no construction-screening warning or change to the partial ocean-view room category. However, the room assignment is still within that category rather than a guaranteed floor or unobstructed view.

All right. The direct access was a major reason to accept the higher Westin total, and that advantage is gone for this stay. Book the refundable Seafarer suite first. Do not cancel the Westin until you confirm the new reservation went through.

The Seafarer one-bedroom king suite is now confirmed for Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson, August 22-28, six nights. The total is $1,493.16, due at check-in, with parking included and no mandatory resort fee. Confirmation number: SJI-6382049. Free cancellation runs through 4:00 p.m. local time on August 20. The Westin reservation remains active at this moment.
Check the dates and guest count one more time on that confirmation.

Verified on SJI-6382049: check-in is Saturday, August 22; check-out is Friday, August 28; the stay is six nights for two adults, Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson. The room is the one-bedroom king suite. There is no reservation for August 21-27.
Good. Now cancel the Westin reservation WJI-8247316. I want the cancellation number and the timing for the deposit refund.

The Westin reservation WJI-8247316 has been canceled within the penalty-free period. Cancellation number: CX-WJI-590184. The full $344.28 deposit is being returned to the original payment method; the hotel states five to seven business days for the credit to appear. No cancellation fee was charged.
Give me the final state plainly. I especially want to know whether there are now two active coastal bookings or only one.

Only one coastal booking is active. Seafarer confirmation SJI-6382049 is confirmed for August 22-28, six nights, two adults, in a one-bedroom king suite at a total of $1,493.16. It remains free to cancel through 4:00 p.m. Jekyll Island local time on August 20. The beach route crosses North Beachview Drive at the marked pedestrian crossing and follows the open public dune path, about three to five minutes from the suite building to the sand. Westin reservation WJI-8247316 is canceled under cancellation number CX-WJI-590184, with the $344.28 deposit due back to the original payment method in five to seven business days. The superseded August 21-27 dates also have no active reservation.
